messages:
laura: Quick q — as we roll out scope-aware routing, should the permissions preview show effective routing policies (quota / burst / preferred-region) per-role? worried it will overwhelm tenant admins.

deepak: I think show a concise summary only. e.g. \"Allowed routes (count) • Max qps • Burst tier\" and a \"details\" link. keep defaults collapsed. :+1:

jessica: Telemetry note: we need a way to tie permission changes to cost/latency impact. propose adding a transient tag/header on requests made during permission sim: `X-Perm-Change-ID: <uuid>` so traces/logs can be correlated.

laura: +1 to the tag. UX question — do we surface the simulation results inline in the preview or open a modal with the breakdown?

ryan: modal feels safer. inline short line: \"Estimated cost delta: -3%\" and a \"view breakdown\" modal that shows routing policy effects and quota hit rates.

jessica: implementation detail: backend can emit log line with tag, e.g.:
```
trace.add_tag(\"perm_change_id\", \"abc-123\")
logger.info(\"perm-sim-request\", {\"perm_change_id\": \"abc-123\", \"route\": \"/v1/generate\", \"qps\": 12})
```
Then use that id to pull telemetry via ES/metrics pipeline.

deepak: sampling concerns — don't want full sampling for every sim. Suggest sampling config like:
`sampling: {filter: \"perm_change_id\", rate: 0.01}` so we capture 1% of tagged runs for detailed traces, but aggregate metrics still roll up.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `scope-preview-v2` -> 10% traffic (2025-06-18T14:03:00Z) :rocket:

laura: ok thanks infra-bot. On the API side: do we expose `/v1/permissions/simulate?routes=true&include_routing=true` or keep it internal and the console calls a cloud-only endpoint?

deepak: we already have `/v1/permissions/simulate` internal-only. exposing it to tenants requires auth + stricter rate-limits. maybe add `expose_to_console=true` flag and a per-tenant quota.

ryan: also add quota caps — simulation can be expensive. enforce `sim_units` quota and a cooldown. otherwise support teams will get paged.

jessica: audit log requirement: any simulate that runs with `perm_change_id` must create an audit entry: `actor, perm_change_id, affected_roles, timestamp, sample_rate`. ops needs that to investigate regressions.

laura: UX follow-ups for rollout: default to OFF for \"Show routing impact\" toggle for tenant admins, add a microcopy: \"May trigger sampling/logging for cost analysis\". we should also warn when estimate is based on low-sample telemetry.

deepak: agreement checklist for PR: add header tagging hook, add sampling filter, create audit event schema, expose small console toggle & modal, add sim_units quota, and update runbooks.

ryan: I'll add rate-limit middleware + quota check. leaving a TODO for metrics: add `perm_sim.cost_delta` gauge and `perm_sim.sampled_traces` counter.

laura: perfect. next step — owners: @deepak backend, @jessica telemetry, @ryan infra, @laura UX. I'll open a tiny RFC and link the canary.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary reached 10% -> healthy.
